comparison.objective: Candidate separates mixed rigid media using a manual screen; pr-1454 loads a caulking gun and lays a continuous sealant bead along a bath joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual load sharing, controlled tilt/agitation, particle passage and retention, then support replacement; pr-1454 tests release-lever/rod coordination, cartridge insertion, trigger-driven extrusion, and continuous nozzle path following. Shared bimanual tool handling is generic.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered-media mass and total washer retention with spill/damage gates, support seating, release, and 3 s dwell; pr-1454 grades loaded-gun state, sealed joint coverage and gap size, mess limits, and putting the gun down. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Continuous material deposition along a joint is mechanically and outcome-wise different from selective separation through apertures.
